proof.gluing_lemma: Each full-product parent has one locally unique regular root branch. At its center with u=0, the exact robust root box is strictly nested in the parent uniqueness box, so both roots agree. On the connected u=0 parent interval, agreement with the global robust continuation branch is nonempty, open by local uniqueness, and closed by continuity, hence holds throughout. Adjacent parents therefore agree at u=0 inside their connected nonempty product overlap. Applying the same open-closed local-uniqueness argument on that full overlap proves that the two branches coincide there.
